tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: Microsoft’s Copilot offers commercial data protection through the University’s institutional licence.
The University does not recommend or endorse any specific GenAI tools.
Some tools, particularly those that are free to use, will request your permission to access and share user data.

data.quote: Do not enter personally identifiable or sensitive information into GenAI platforms.
Do not share others’ personal, identifiable, or sensitive information with GenAI platforms unless you have their express consent.

Do not enter personally identifiable or sensitive information into GenAI platforms. Some platforms store the interactions, which may constitute a data breach under the Data Protection Act and UK GDPR 2018. This includes research data.
Do not place copyrighted information into GenAI platforms for processing.

Do not place copyrighted information into GenAI platforms for processing. This includes your course notes, assessments, slides and other content produced by University staff. Do not put these into GenAI platforms unless the academic concerned gives written permission.

safeguards.quote: It is essential to be aware of the terms and conditions section of the GenAI tools you are using, as each platform that provides these tools has its unique terms and conditions.
To securely access Copilot log into copilot.microsoft.com using your CCCU credentials.

legal.quote: Do not share others’ personal, identifiable, or sensitive information with GenAI platforms unless you have their express consent. If you do so, you may be in breach of the UKs Data Protection Act 2018 and Europe’s GDPR laws.

In the UK, copyright law gives a person ownership rights over the things they create unless a copyright exemption exists. GenAI produces outputs based on existing works and training data that may include exact reproductions or illegal copies.
It is essential to be aware of the terms and conditions section of the GenAI tools you are using, as each platform that provides these tools has its unique terms and conditions.
